boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Northwest University
boards.description: Ten Kirkland food stops with official pages documenting evening availability; confirm the applicable day’s service option before leaving campus.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill Totem Lake
cards.subtitle: 12530 Totem Lake Blvd NE, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to check the current 11 PM closing time, then choose in-store pickup or delivery before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A Totem Lake option with official daily hours listed through 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official location page lists this Kirkland restaurant at 12530 Totem Lake Blvd NE and daily restaurant hours of 10:45 AM–11 PM.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill in Kirkland, WA
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours Monday–Sunday, 10:45 AM–11 PM; in-store pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Totem Lake
cards.subtitle: 12026 NE 124th St, Kirkland
cards.notes: Check the day before going: the official page lists 11 PM drive-thru and delivery availability Monday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Totem Lake stop whose official service hours extend to 11 PM on operating days.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A’s official Totem Lake page lists Monday–Saturday hours through 11 PM, with drive-thru and delivery available through 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru and delivery Monday–Saturday until 11 PM; dine-in and carry-out end at 10 PM; closed Sundays.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza at 13501 100th Avenue NE
cards.subtitle: 13501 100th Avenue NE, Suite 10, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the store page immediately before ordering, since it directs customers to its current local hours and supports carryout or delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Kirkland pizza location whose official page currently reports midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies this Kirkland location at 13501 100th Avenue NE, Suite 10 and currently states it is open until 12 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 13501 100th Avenue NE Suite 10
cards.access_notes: Official page currently displays “Open Today Until 12:00 AM” and notes that store hours vary by location; verify before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza at 8431 122nd Avenue NE
cards.subtitle: 8431 122nd Ave NE, Kirkland
cards.notes: Open this location’s official page before departing to confirm service and place a carryout or delivery order for the evening.
cards.short_summary: A second, distinct Kirkland Domino’s location listed by the company’s local directory.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Kirkland directory lists a distinct store at 8431 122nd Ave NE and reports it as open until 12 AM in the nearby-locations listing.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 13501 100th Avenue NE Suite 10
cards.access_notes: The official Domino’s page lists the 8431 122nd Ave NE Kirkland store as open until 12 AM; confirm the store-specific status before travel.

cards.title: McDonald's at 12440 NE 144th
cards.subtitle: 12440 NE 144th St, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the official location page to compare lobby and drive-thru times; late service differs by day and option.
cards.short_summary: A Kirkland location with official Friday and Saturday drive-thru hours through 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page lists this Kirkland restaurant’s lobby through midnight Friday and Saturday and drive-thru through 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list lobby service to 12 AM Friday–Saturday and drive-thru to 1 AM Friday–Saturday; other days close earlier.

cards.title: MOD Pizza Totem Lake
cards.subtitle: 12530 Totem Lake Blvd, Suite 124, Kirkland
cards.notes: Plan this stop for Thursday through Saturday evenings, when the official location page lists an 11 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A Totem Lake pizza-and-salad location with later weekend-adjacent hours.
cards.evidence_claim: MOD Pizza’s official Totem Lake page lists Thursday, Friday, and Saturday hours of 10:30 AM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11 PM closing Thursday–Saturday and 10 PM closing on the other listed days.

cards.title: Zeitoon Grill
cards.subtitle: 21 Central Way, Kirkland
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for a Friday or Saturday dinner; the restaurant’s own site lists service until 10 PM on both days.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Kirkland Persian restaurant with 10 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Zeitoon Grill’s official site lists its Kirkland address and Friday and Saturday hours of 12 PM–10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday service until 10 PM; it lists 9 PM closes Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday, and Monday closed.

cards.title: Ruk Thai Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 6509 132nd Ave NE, Kirkland
cards.notes: For a later dinner, use the restaurant contact page and target Friday or Saturday, when its posted hours run to 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Kirkland Thai restaurant with official Friday and Saturday 10 PM hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruk Thai’s official contact page lists its Kirkland address and Friday–Saturday hours from 11 AM to 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 11 AM–10 PM Friday–Saturday and 11 AM–9 PM Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Sparrow Kirkland
cards.subtitle: 9736 NE 120th Pl, Kirkland
cards.notes: Check the reservation page for the applicable evening; it says listed closing time is the last seating for a complete dining experience.
cards.short_summary: A Kirkland restaurant posting 10 PM last-seating times Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparrow’s official contact page lists its Kirkland address and 10 PM listed closing times Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page states the listed closing time is last seating; it lists 10 PM Thursday–Saturday and 9 PM on other days.

cards.title: Hearth Restaurant
cards.subtitle: The Heathman Hotel Kirkland, downtown Kirkland
cards.notes: For a late evening visit, confirm current service directly: the restaurant page lists a 9–10 PM late-night happy-hour window Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown hotel restaurant that officially lists late-night service Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Hearth Restaurant’s official page lists restaurant hours until 10 PM Monday–Saturday and a late-night happy-hour period from 9–10 PM Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours to 10 PM Monday–Saturday; dinner service is listed to 9 PM, while late-night happy hour runs 9–10 PM Tuesday–Saturday.
